27.zh: 过了基利家 、 旁非利亚前面的海，就到了吕家的每拉。
27.en: When we had sailed across the open sea off the coast of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we landed at Myra in Lycia.

27.zh: 在那里，百夫长遇见一只亚力山大的船，要往义大利去，便叫我们上了那船。
27.en: There the centurion found an Alexandrian ship sailing for Italy and put us on board.

27.zh: 一连多日，船行得慢，仅仅来到革尼土的对面。因为被风拦阻，就贴著革哩底背风岸，从撒摩尼对面行过。
27.en: We made slow headway for many days and had difficulty arriving off Cnidus. When the wind did not allow us to hold our course, we sailed to the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

27.zh: 我们沿岸行走，仅仅来到一个地方，名叫佳澳；离那里不远，有拉西亚城。
27.en: We moved along the coast with difficulty and came to a place called Fair Havens, near the town of Lasea.

27.zh: 走的日子多了，已经过了禁食的节期，行船又危险，保罗就劝众人说：
27.en: Much time had been lost, and sailing had already become dangerous because by now it was after the Fast. So Paul warned them,

27.zh: 众位，我看这次行船，不但货物和船要受伤损，大遭破坏，连我们的性命也难保。
27.en: "Men, I can see that our voyage is going to be disastrous and bring great loss to ship and cargo, and to our own lives also."

27.zh: 但百夫长信从掌船的和船主，不信从保罗所说的。
27.en: But the centurion, instead of listening to what Paul said, followed the advice of the pilot and of the owner of the ship.

27.zh: 且因在这海口过冬不便，船上的人就多半说：不如开船离开这地方，或者能到非尼基过冬。非尼基是革哩底的一个海口，一面朝东北，一面朝东南。
27.en: Since the harbor was unsuitable to winter in, the majority decided that we should sail on, hoping to reach Phoenix and winter there. This was a harbor in Crete, facing both southwest and northwest.

27.zh: 这时，微微起了南风，他们以为得意，就起了锚，贴近革哩底行去。
27.en: When a gentle south wind began to blow, they thought they had obtained what they wanted; so they weighed anchor and sailed along the shore of Crete.

27.zh: 不多几时，狂风从岛上扑下来；那风名叫友拉革罗。
27.en: Before very long, a wind of hurricane force, called the "northeaster," swept down from the island.

27.zh: 船被风抓住，敌不住风，我们就任风刮去。
27.en: The ship was caught by the storm and could not head into the wind; so we gave way to it and were driven along.

27.zh: 贴著一个小岛的背风岸奔行，那岛名叫高大，在那里仅仅收住了小船。
27.en: As we passed to the lee of a small island called Cauda, we were hardly able to make the lifeboat secure.

27.zh: 既然把小船拉上来，就用缆索捆绑船底，又恐怕在赛耳底沙滩上搁了浅，就落下篷来，任船飘去。
27.en: When the men had hoisted it aboard, they passed ropes under the ship itself to hold it together. Fearing that they would run aground on the sandbars of Syrtis, they lowered the sea anchor and let the ship be driven along.

27.zh: 我们被风浪逼得甚急，第二天众人就把货物抛在海里。
27.en: We took such a violent battering from the storm that the next day they began to throw the cargo overboard.

27.zh: 到第三天，他们又亲手把船上的器具抛弃了。
27.en: On the third day, they threw the ship's tackle overboard with their own hands.

27.zh: 太阳和星辰多日不显露，又有狂风大浪催逼，我们得救的指望就都绝了。
27.en: When neither sun nor stars appeared for many days and the storm continued raging, we finally gave up all hope of being saved.

27.zh: 众人多日没有吃甚么，保罗就出来站在他们中间，说：众位，你们本该听我的话，不离开革哩底，免得遭这样的伤损破坏。
27.en: After the men had gone a long time without food, Paul stood up before them and said: "Men, you should have taken my advice not to sail from Crete; then you would have spared yourselves this damage and loss.

27.zh: 现在我还劝你们放心，你们的性命一个也不失丧，惟独失丧这船。
27.en: But now I urge you to keep up your courage, because not one of you will be lost; only the ship will be destroyed.

27.zh: 因我所属所事奉的神，他的使者昨夜站在我旁边，说：
27.en: Last night an angel of the God whose I am and whom I serve stood beside me

27.zh: 保罗，不要害怕，你必定站在该撒面前，并且与你同船的人，神都赐给你了。
27.en: and said, 'Do not be afraid, Paul. You must stand trial before Caesar; and God has graciously given you the lives of all who sail with you.'

27.zh: 所以众位可以放心，我信神他怎样对我说：事情也要怎样成就。
27.en: So keep up your courage, men, for I have faith in God that it will happen just as he told me.

27.zh: 只是我们必要撞在一个岛上。
27.en: Nevertheless, we must run aground on some island."

27.zh: 到了第十四天夜间，船在亚底亚海飘来飘去。约到半夜，水手以为渐近旱地，
27.en: On the fourteenth night we were still being driven across the Adriatic Sea, when about midnight the sailors sensed they were approaching land.

27.zh: 就探深浅，探得有十二丈；稍往前行，又探深浅，探得有九丈。
27.en: They took soundings and found that the water was a hundred and twenty feet deep. A short time later they took soundings again and found it was ninety feet deep.

27.zh: 恐怕撞在石头上，就从船尾抛下四个锚，盼望天亮。
27.en: Fearing that we would be dashed against the rocks, they dropped four anchors from the stern and prayed for daylight.

27.zh: 水手想要逃出船去，把小船放在海里，假作要从船头抛锚的样子。
27.en: In an attempt to escape from the ship, the sailors let the lifeboat down into the sea, pretending they were going to lower some anchors from the bow.

27.zh: 保罗对百夫长和兵丁说：这些人若不等在船上，你们必不能得救。
27.en: Then Paul said to the centurion and the soldiers, "Unless these men stay with the ship, you cannot be saved."

27.zh: 于是兵丁砍断小船的绳子，由他飘去。
27.en: So the soldiers cut the ropes that held the lifeboat and let it fall away.

27.zh: 天渐亮的时候，保罗劝众人都吃饭，说：你们悬望忍饿不吃甚么，已经十四天了。
27.en: Just before dawn Paul urged them all to eat. "For the last fourteen days," he said, "you have been in constant suspense and have gone without food-- you haven't eaten anything.

27.zh: 所以我劝你们吃饭，这是关乎你们救命的事；因为你们各人连一根头发也不至于损坏。
27.en: Now I urge you to take some food. You need it to survive. Not one of you will lose a single hair from his head."

27.zh: 保罗说了这话，就拿著饼，在众人面前祝谢了神，擘开吃。
27.en: After he said this, he took some bread and gave thanks to God in front of them all. Then he broke it and began to eat.

27.zh: 于是他们都放下心，也就吃了。
27.en: They were all encouraged and ate some food themselves.

27.zh: 我们在船上的共有二百七十六个人。
27.en: Altogether there were 276 of us on board.

27.zh: 他们吃饱了，就把船上的麦子抛在海里，为要叫船轻一点。
27.en: When they had eaten as much as they wanted, they lightened the ship by throwing the grain into the sea.

27.zh: 到了天亮，他们不认识那地方，但见一个海湾，有岸可登，就商议能把船拢进去不能。
27.en: When daylight came, they did not recognize the land, but they saw a bay with a sandy beach, where they decided to run the ship aground if they could.

27.zh: 于是砍断缆索，弃锚在海里；同时也松开舵绳，拉起头篷，顺著风向岸行去。
27.en: Cutting loose the anchors, they left them in the sea and at the same time untied the ropes that held the rudders. Then they hoisted the foresail to the wind and made for the beach.

27.zh: 但遇著两水夹流的地方，就把船搁了浅；船头胶住不动，船尾被浪的猛力冲坏。
27.en: But the ship struck a sandbar and ran aground. The bow stuck fast and would not move, and the stern was broken to pieces by the pounding of the surf.

27.zh: 兵丁的意思要把囚犯杀了，恐怕有洑水脱逃的。
27.en: The soldiers planned to kill the prisoners to prevent any of them from swimming away and escaping.

27.zh: 但百夫长要救保罗，不准他们任意而行，就吩咐会洑水的，跳下水去先上岸；
27.en: But the centurion wanted to spare Paul's life and kept them from carrying out their plan. He ordered those who could swim to jump overboard first and get to land.

27.zh: 其余的人可以用板子或船上的零碎东西上岸。这样，众人都得了救，上了岸。
27.en: The rest were to get there on planks or on pieces of the ship. In this way everyone reached land in safety.

28.zh: 我们既已得救，才知道那岛名叫米利大。
28.en: Once safely on shore, we foundout that the island was called Malta.

28.zh: 土人看待我们，有非常的情分；因为当时下雨，天气又冷，就生火接待我们众人。
28.en: The islanders showed us unusual kindness. They built a fire and welcomed us all because it was raining and cold.

28.zh: 那时，保罗拾起一捆柴，放在火上，有一条毒蛇，因为热了出来，咬住他的手。
28.en: Paul gathered a pile of brushwood and, as he put it on the fire, a viper, driven out by the heat, fastened itself on his hand.

28.zh: 土人看见那毒蛇悬在他手上，就彼此说：这人必是个凶手，虽然从海里救上来，天理还不容他活著。
28.en: When the islanders saw the snake hanging from his hand, they said to each other, "This man must be a murderer; for though he escaped from the sea, Justice has not allowed him to live."

28.zh: 保罗竟把那毒蛇甩在火里，并没有受伤。
28.en: But Paul shook the snake off into the fire and suffered no ill effects.

28.zh: 土人想他必要肿起来，或是忽然仆倒死了；看了多时，见他无害，就转念，说：他是个神。
28.en: The people expected him to swell up or suddenly fall dead, but after waiting a long time and seeing nothing unusual happen to him, they changed their minds and said he was a god.

28.zh: 离那地方不远，有田产是岛长部百流的；他接纳我们，尽情款待三日。
28.en: There was an estate nearby that belonged to Publius, the chief official of the island. He welcomed us to his home and for three days entertained us hospitably.

28.zh: 当时，部百流的父亲患热病和痢疾躺著。保罗进去，为他祷告，按手在他身上，治好了他。
28.en: His father was sick in bed, suffering from fever and dysentery. Paul went in to see him and, after prayer, placed his hands on him and healed him.

28.zh: 从此，岛上其余的病人也来，得了医治。
28.en: When this had happened, the rest of the sick on the island came and were cured.

28.zh: 他们又多方的尊敬我们；到了开船的时候，也把我们所需用的送到船上。
28.en: They honored us in many ways and when we were ready to sail, they furnished us with the supplies we needed.

28.zh: 过了三个月，我们上了亚力山大的船往前行；这船以丢斯双子为记，是在那海岛过了冬的。
28.en: After three months we put out to sea in a ship that had wintered in the island. It was an Alexandrian ship with the figurehead of the twin gods Castor and Pollux.

28.zh: 到了叙拉古，我们停泊三日；
28.en: We put in at Syracuse and stayed there three days.

28.zh: 又从那里绕行，来到利基翁。过了一天，起了南风，第二天就来到部丢利。
28.en: From there we set sail and arrived at Rhegium. The next day the south wind came up, and on the following day we reached Puteoli.

28.zh: 在那里遇见弟兄们，请我们与他们同住了七天。这样，我们来到罗马。
28.en: There we found some brothers who invited us to spend a week with them. And so we came to Rome.

28.zh: 那里的弟兄们一听见我们的信息就出来，到亚比乌市和三馆地方迎接我们。保罗见了他们，就感谢神，放心壮胆。
28.en: The brothers there had heard that we were coming, and they traveled as far as the Forum of Appius and the Three Taverns to meet us. At the sight of these men Paul thanked God and was encouraged.

28.zh: 进了罗马城，（有古卷在此有：百夫长把众囚犯交给御营的统领，惟有）保罗蒙准和一个看守他的兵另住在一处。
28.en: When we got to Rome, Paul was allowed to live by himself, with a soldier to guard him.

28.zh: 过了三天，保罗请犹太人的首领来。他们来了，就对他们说：弟兄们，我虽没有做甚么事干犯本国的百姓和我们祖宗的规条，却被锁绑，从耶路撒冷解在罗马人的手里。
28.en: Three days later he called together the leaders of the Jews. When they had assembled, Paul said to them: "My brothers, although I have done nothing against our people or against the customs of our ancestors, I was arrested in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.

28.zh: 他们审问了我，就愿意释放我；因为在我身上，并没有该死的罪。罪。
28.en: They examined me and wanted to release me, because I was not guilty of any crime deserving death.

28.zh: 无奈犹太人不服，我不得已，只好上告于该撒，并非有甚么事要控告我本国的百姓。
28.en: But when the Jews objected, I was compelled to appeal to Caesar--not that I had any charge to bring against my own people.

28.zh: 因此，我请你们来见面说话，我原为以色列人所指望的，被这炼子捆锁。
28.en: For this reason I have asked to see you and talk with you. It is because of the hope of Israel that I am bound with this chain."

28.zh: 他们说：我们并没有接著从犹太来论你的信，也没有弟兄到这里来报给我们说你有甚么不好处。
28.en: They replied, "We have not received any letters from Judea concerning you, and none of the brothers who have come from there has reported or said anything bad about you.

28.zh: 但我们愿意听你的意见如何；因为这教门，我们晓得是到处被毁谤的。
28.en: But we want to hear what your views are, for we know that people everywhere are talking against this sect."

28.zh: 他们和保罗约定了日子，就有许多人到他的寓处来。保罗从早到晚，对他们讲论这事，证明神国的道，引摩西的律法和先知的书，以耶稣的事劝勉他们。
28.en: They arranged to meet Paul on a certain day, and came in even larger numbers to the place where he was staying. From morning till evening he explained and declared to them the kingdom of God and tried to convince them about Jesus from the Law of Moses and from the Prophets.

28.zh: 他所说的话，有信的，有不信的。
28.en: Some were convinced by what he said, but others would not believe.

28.zh: 他们彼此不合，就散了；未散以先，保罗说了一句话，说：圣灵藉先知以赛亚向你们祖宗所说的话是不错的。
28.en: They disagreed among themselves and began to leave after Paul had made this final statement: "The Holy Spirit spoke the truth to your forefathers when he said through Isaiah the prophet:

28.zh: 他说：你去告诉这百姓说：你们听是要听见，却不明白；看是要看见，却不晓得；
28.en: " 'Go to this people and say, "You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving."

28.zh: 因为这百姓油蒙了心，耳朵发沉，眼睛闭著；恐怕眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里明白，回转过来，我就医治他们。
28.en: For this people's heart has become calloused; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts and turn, and I would heal them.'

28.zh: 所以你们当知道，神这救恩，如今传给外邦人，他们也必听受。（有古卷在此有：
28.en: "Therefore I want you to know that God's salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!"

28.zh: 保罗说了这话，犹太人议论纷纷的就走了。）
28.en: After he said this, the Jews left, arguing vigorously among themselves.

28.zh: 保罗在自己所租的房子里住了足足两年。凡来见他的人，他全都接待，
28.en: For two whole years Paul stayed there in his own rented house and welcomed all who came to see him.

28.zh: 放胆传讲神国的道，将主耶稣基督的事教导人，并没有人禁止。
